question_en: Which evidence best demonstrates that E-26.02 service objectives were achieved after a component change?
options: Post-service test results verified against the applicable system requirements.
explanation_en: E-26.02 requires appropriate component selection followed by testing and verification according to applicable requirements.
explanation_es: E-26.02 exige selección apropiada del componente seguida de pruebas y verificación según requisitos aplicables.
